title: DATE ( 2024, 1, 31 ) = "2024-01-31" fails: a date is not compared with text

expected.error: comparison of a Date/time value with a Text value is not supported

source.quote: Other mixed data-type comparisons will return an error
source.supports: only Numeric/Numeric, Boolean/Boolean and String/String comparisons are supported

source.quote: DAX doesn't do any implicit conversions for Boolean or string values
source.supports: the other reading: no conversion, and the comparison returns a value

derivation: The operator reference supports comparison only for Numeric with Numeric, Boolean with Boolean and String with String, and Date/time counts as numeric. A date against a string is a mixed comparison and returns an error.
alternative: The data types page says a string is simply greater than any number or date and shows "12" = 12 as false: under that reading the result is FALSE. If the text were read as a date the result would be TRUE.
